in_sanskrit.name: Neysa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nectar, Sweet
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Neysa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neyam' meaning 'nectar'. This name is associated with the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Saraswati. The name 'Neysa' symbolizes the sweetness and purity of knowledge and the wisdom it imparts.
